description: Synthetic Ground-Motion Records for 100 Bridge Sites in Indiana is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by George Mavroeidis, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). This dataset contains synthetic ground-motion time histories from scenario earthquakes generated for 100 bridge sites across the State of Indiana. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-n5b6-4051. Keywords: Synthetic Ground Motions, Seismic Hazard Deaggregation, Deterministic and Stochastic Simulations, Site Response Analysis, Bridge Seismic Vulnerability. Published 2020-12-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
